notes.title: Our august playtest is now over
notes.content: [p]Our playtest, which ran for most of august, is now over. Thank you so very much to everyone who tried our game, streamed it, and found new [strike]bugs[/strike] features.[/p][p][/p][p]A few stats for the nerds :[/p][list][*][p]Around 200 people signed up for the playtest[/p][/*][*][p]70 unique players played the game[/p][/*][*][p]the median play time was around 50 minutes[/p][/*][*][p]it got streamed on twitch by 2 streamers ([url="https://www.twitch.tv/ulysseshg"]ulysses[/url] and [url="https://www.twitch.tv/roniini"]roniini[/url])[/p][/*][*][p]we also got our [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lsDK3uUhbEA"]first gameplay video on youtube[/url][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]All in all we're super pumped by all the feedback we have gotten during this months and we can't wait to integrate some of it into the game and do another round of playtesting.[/p][p][/p][p]If you'd like to keep in touch, suggest changes or tell us about some new features you found, [url="https://discord.gg/hFdH6XK5ec"]please join our discord[/url].[/p]

notes.title: It's playtest time !
notes.content: [p]Greetings space farmers, the day you’ve been waiting for has finally arrived ![/p][p]We’re opening up our playtest to everyone for one month. Grab the game, grab your friends, build wild defenses and make sure your dome generator survives for 10 days ![/p][p]We’d love to see your creations so don’t forget to post your screenshots in the community hub or on our discord. And if you want to help us make the perfect game, follow the link to the feedback form in the game’s main screen.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSedZySclvaPcyBH9csI5SqUk2Uv8Wi4WJrcGq1AXbSZQfNmyQ/viewform" style="button"]Give us feedback[/url][/p]
